metadata.grayscale_transformation: original 250x250 RGB -> PIL convert("L") (ITU-R 601 luma) -> convert("RGB") to replicate across 3 channels
metadata.preprocessing: MobileNetV2 preprocess_input (x/127.5 - 1) applied AFTER grayscale+resize; grayscale is never applied after normalization

clean_fp_stability.summary: 2 of 6 clean false positives changed class under grayscale.
clean_fp_stability.note: n=6: descriptive only, no statistical inference.

limitations: Grayscale removes hue and saturation jointly.
The model was not trained on grayscale images.
Therefore degradation can reflect distribution shift rather than shortcut reliance.
Results establish sensitivity to color removal, not causality.
Results apply only to this frozen model and this test distribution.
This is not an OOD benchmark.
